{"subject":"p99 latency in a multi-region data layer","body":"Hi Tom,

Northwind Payments' team is focused on capacity planning and on evaluating cost and latency improvements for its multi-region data layer and Kafka estate.

If tail latency is part of that evaluation, ScyllaDB is built on a shard-per-core C++ architecture with no JVM garbage-collection pauses, so p99 latency stays predictable.

Would you be open to comparing notes on p99 behavior as that evaluation takes shape?

Oz
GTM Engineer, ScyllaDB

Reply STOP to opt out.","evidence_ids":["s02"],"value_prop_ids":["vp_latency"],"context_fact_ids":[]}
